plugins.description: Ten Claude skills for intraday trading on NSE and BSE: a chart scanner, a news monitor with NSE announcements, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager with Zerodha charges, a Kite order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts and an insider and bulk / block deal tracker.
